arguments.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this adult cartoon mermaid game sprite. Image 1 is the existing drawing; image 2 is its exact original, with diagnostic red/white skin stippling. The user's correction takes precedence over the prior rendering: Change only the visible facial expression to an easy playful smile, bright amused eye, relaxed brow and lifted cheek. Preserve the existing low right-facing swimming pose, partial forearm at the water surface, exposed tail, hair, waterline and every other shape. Retain her established adult identity, golden-blonde hair, turquoise hairband, tan skin and green swimwear/tail wherever already visible. Keep the current cel shading and clean dark outlines. Mood happy and playful, not sad or stoic. Keep source occlusions except the explicitly requested face adjustment. Output the whole sprite with generous padding on an actually transparent background. No checkerboard, labels, scenery, ground or extra anatomy.
